description: Elections Commission - Declare that W. N. S. W. Weerasinghe was selected as the member of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member through the recognized political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local authority membership, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
